stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 rev-list [--topo-order] [--date-order] [--reverse] [--]
                      <revspec>...

List commits in reverse chronological order.

This command lists commit objects in reverse chronological order,
starting from the given commits. You can specify ranges, exclusions,
and use --not to toggle including/excluding commits.

Revision specifications:
  <commit>          - Include commit and its ancestors
  ^<commit>         - Exclude commit and its ancestors
  <commit>..<commit> - Range (exclude first, include second)
  --not <commits>   - Toggle exclusion for following commits

Options:
    <revspec>...
        revision specification(s)
    --topo-order
        show commits in topological order
    --date-order
        show commits in date order
    --reverse
        reverse the commit ordering
